name: Suella Braverman

lean.basis: Conservative MP from 2015, Attorney General and twice Home Secretary on the party's right (sacked by Rishi Sunak in November 2023 over an article on policing of pro-Palestinian marches); defected to Reform UK in January 2026, saying she could no longer trust the Conservatives.

current_role: Reform UK MP for Fareham and Waterlooville (defected from the Conservatives in January 2026)
summary: Suella Braverman was Attorney General (2020–2022) and Home Secretary under Liz Truss and Rishi Sunak, who sacked her in November 2023. At NatCon London in 2023 she warned that uncontrolled immigration threatened Britain's "national character", and she spoke at NatCon Brussels in April 2024 as police tried to close it. On January 26, 2026 she defected to Nigel Farage's Reform UK, praising him as uniquely consistent.
